note: Which of the validator's rules are accessibility rules, and the WCAG success criterion each one answers. A finding from one of these rules is a warning, never an error, unless the project's accessibilityBlockers names it (docs/validator-spec.md). This file stands in for the shared accessibility catalogue (C2, A11Y-1) until the core publishes it; when it does, this file is replaced by it, and the rule ids that match keep their meaning. 'since' is the version of WCAG that added the criterion; a criterion from 2.2 is named so, because the law's floor is 2.1 AA and Author aims for 2.2 AA.
